status: Rules fixed before computing subgroup error summaries; exploratory post-review analysis, not preregistration
scope_reason: Verified SMILES-to-prediction mapping available for these two datasets in neighbor_results; no unverified mapping used for fathead minnow
consistent_direction_requirement: All five splits eligible and same sign of mean delta; descriptive, not statistical significance
primary_measure: mean over chemicals of mean absolute error across five model seeds; delta = G2 minus descriptor-only
secondary_measures: fraction of chemicals with negative delta
sensitivity: All nine graph settings; report full results rather than select favorable settings
structure_handling: Parse supplied SMILES using RDKit default sanitization; no salt stripping, tautomer normalization, neutralization or restandardization. Structural flags apply to supplied molecular representation. Canonical SMILES used only to audit identity, not to change prediction joins.
inferential_tests: None. Overlapping groups and repeated chemicals across scaffold splits are dependent. No claim of chemical-class causal effects.
